questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Let $S = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}$. Then the number of one-one functions $f : S \rightarrow P(S)$, where $P(S)$ denote the power set of S, such that $f(n) \subset f(m)$ where $n < m$ is ________.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
Let $f^1(x) = \frac{3x + 2}{2x + 3}, x \in \mathbb{R} - \left\{-\frac{3}{2}\right\}$.
For $n \ge 2$, define $f^n(x) = f^1 \circ f^{n-1}(x)$.
If $f^5(x) = \frac{ax + b}{bx + a}$, $\gcd(a, b) = 1$, then $a + b$ is equal to ________.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{48}{x^4} \int_0^x \frac{t^3}{t^6 + 1} dt$ is equal to ________.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The mean and variance of 7 observations are 8 and 16 respectively. If one observation 14 is omitted and a and b are respectively mean and variance of remaining 6 observation, then $a + 3b - 5$ is equal to ________.
